canvas.$description: Page canvas — the neutral reading surface between demo zones.

canvas-subtle.$description: Raised surface for cards and code blocks.

canvas-muted.$description: Recessed surface for inline code and table headers. Neutral, not branded — tinted chrome makes the whole page read as one colour wash.

ink.$description: Body text (16.6:1 on the page canvas).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text and captions (10.6:1 on the page canvas).

border.$description: Neutral rather than branded, but still 3.4:1 against the card surface: components inherit this for control affordances (card, checkbox, dialog), so it has to clear the non-text threshold. The site's own decorative rules soften it via --cw-rule.
